Flash - [Manifest: "Contractor Hermes" & C4 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) While this card is in Hand, when it is discarded by an effect, or any card is put onto the opposing Removed Zone, you can [Mani] this card, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1-2-3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
You can send up to two opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Removed Zone. Then, once per turn, you can refresh one of your "HeroBeast".

[LV2-3] (Your Attack Step)
When any card is put onto the opposing Removed Zone, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14314.name: Vizarga Bellagio (Card)
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14314.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Cost 3 or more, "Gai-Asura") (Core Charge via summon/advent only once per turn)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can return a "Gai-Asura"-named Spirit card and an exactly-named "The Phantom Star Creation Place" from your Trash to the Hand. Then, you can put three cores from the Void to this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a Spirit with two or more reduction symbol colors you control.
